key_insight: Randomized orthogonal mixing and progressive residual-sign coding enable training-free Transformer weight compression with fidelity that improves as residual stages are added.
engineering_relevance: The method offers flexible storage–fidelity trade-offs without learned codebooks, empirical CDFs, or trellis optimization.
method: Apply randomized orthogonal mixing to promote Gaussian-like residual distributions.
Independently normalize residuals and analytically calibrate sign-based reconstruction at each stage.
Progressively encode residual errors to recover quantization fidelity.
evidence_signal: Across attention and MLP projections, five-stage joint quantization yields perplexities of 32.16 for GPT-2 Large and 12.73 for Llama-3-8B, versus full-precision baselines of 29.89 and 11.07.
watch_item: Additional residual stages improve fidelity but increase storage; deployment should assess runtime costs and statistics overhead.
paper_title: Orthogonally Mixed Sign Coding with Progressive Residual Refinement for Transformer Weight Compression
